messages:
tara_cs: Hey team — multiple customers (acct 842, 917) saying per-model throughput lines in Console dropped to 0 around 02:10 UTC. API still returns 200 and models are serving. Can someone take a look?

anna_support: Seeing same in the support queue. No recent deploys from apps team. Dashboards show flatlines for model-specific series but overall cluster QPS looks unchanged (total tokens graph ok).

leo_eng-platform: Noted. Which panels exactly? link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/throughput/models?org=prod

tara_cs: The per-model sparklines and the template row that breaks out by model_id. Panels that use label model_id (e.g., model_qps{model_id=~"$model"}) are blank.

sam_eng-sre: Quick check — prom scrape still running. I queried prometheus: `up{job="model-exporter"}` -> all 1. But `count by (model_id)(rate(model_qps[5m]))` returns 0 series.

marco_oncall: I pulled /metrics from one exporter on prod:
```
# HELP model_qps Query per-second
# TYPE model_qps gauge
model_qps{model_name="gpt-2-medium",region="us-west"} 12.3
model_qps{model_name="gpt-4-small",region="us-west"} 7.1
```

marco_oncall: Notice label is model_name, not model_id. Grafana panels expect model_id label.

leo_eng-platform: Aha. We pushed exporter v0.9.2 at 01:58 UTC which renamed label model_id -> model_name for readability. We must have missed updating the dashboard template variables.

anna_support: Customers care about continuity. Is there a quick fix?

sam_eng-sre: Short term: update the dashboard queries to use either label name via an OR or fallback. e.g. `label_replace(model_qps, "model_id", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")` is messy. Better: add a Prometheus relabeling rule to copy model_name -> model_id at scrape time, or add a compatibility label in the exporter.

leo_eng-platform: I can push a quick scrape relabel to the prometheus config to set `replacement: $1` from model_name to model_id, but that needs reload and will take a minute to show up. Who can authorize?

tara_cs: Please go ahead, we have an open escalation (P2) from two paying customers.

sam_eng-sre: I applied a relabel_config on the scrape job to create `model_id` from `model_name` and reloaded Prometheus (promtool check passed).

grafana_bot: Grafana alert: Panel "Per-model QPS (prod)" had 0 series -> changed to 18 series after dashboard variable refresh.

marco_oncall: Confirming in Console — per-model lines reappearing. Back to normal for us (visible for 7 minutes).

tara_cs: I told the customers it's fixed and asked them to confirm. One replied: "Thanks — charts back, appreciate the quick turnaround" :thumbsup:

leo_eng-platform: Long term action items: (1) Add compatibility labels in exporter (emit both model_name and model_id) or document the rename in release notes; (2) Add a Prometheus unit test that detects label name changes that would break templated dashboards; (3) update dashboard templates to query using `model_name` as well.

anna_support: Filing a follow-up ticket and linking release that caused it so support can pre-warn next time.

sam_eng-sre: Adding to eng-platform backlog: LABEL-2133 "Exporter label compatibility and dashboard resilience".

marco_oncall: Note: customer-visible impact window ~12 minutes (deploy -> relabel -> scrapes -> grafana cache). Logging this in the incident notes.

tara_cs: Thanks everyone — closing the escalation once customers acknowledge.
